summary: TOR Electric shows an Established digital presence (Digital Maturity 62/100) with strong reputation signals (4.9 stars, 122 reviews, 98% 4-5 star) and solid SEO/booking foundations. Audit isolates addressable website issues: mobile performance is Poor at 45/100 with LCP 25.2s, rather than site-wide failure (SEO 92/100, HTTPS true, 0/6 broken links).

topOpportunities.title: Fix Poor mobile performance - LCP 25.2s blocking above-fold render
topOpportunities.evidence: Lighthouse mobile performance: 45/100; largest contentful paint: 25155ms (25.2s); firstContentfulPaintMs: 10249ms; interactiveMs: 25178ms; totalBlockingTimeMs: 435ms
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Mobile visitors currently wait 25.2s for largest content and 10.2s for first paint; faster load may reduce abandonment before seeing CTAs/booking link, though actual visitor drop-off was not measured.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Prioritize Shopify performance triage: defer unused JavaScript (Est savings of 515 KiB), reduce JavaScript execution time (1.9s), minimize main-thread work (5.0s), and compress/resize homepage images. Re-test Lighthouse on https://tor-electric.com/ to validate LCP <2.5s.

topOpportunities.title: Complete image alt text and related accessibility fixes
topOpportunities.evidence: Image alt-text coverage: 25% on homepage with Images: 8; Lighthouse failure: Image elements do not have [alt] attributes
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: With only 25% alt coverage and Lighthouse accessibility 84/100, screen-reader users and image search may miss context; improving alt text can broaden accessibility without changing design.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text to all 8 homepage images (especially service/hero images) and fix related accessibility flags: heading-order, aria-hidden focus, and frame/iframe titles. Keep 25% baseline to measure improvement to 100%.

topOpportunities.title: Expand brief 58-character meta description to clarify offer
topOpportunities.evidence: Meta description length: 58 characters; description: Trusted Electricians Bringing Unparalleled Service to Utah; Page title: Tor Electric – TOR-Electric
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Current 58-character description is too brief to fully explain the offer in search results; a clearer description may improve click-through from already-strong SEO 92/100 foundation.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Expand homepage meta description to 140-160 characters that states core services (EV charger, panel/meter upgrades), service area (Wasatch Front/Salt Lake City), and CTA, while keeping existing title. Use GA4 to monitor CTR after change.

topOpportunities.title: Add missing structured data for Electrician/LocalBusiness
topOpportunities.evidence: Structured data: not found; JSON-LD structured data blocks: 0; hasSchema: false
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Zero JSON-LD blocks means search engines lack explicit entity data; adding schema could support eligibility for rich results and knowledge panel consistency alongside claimed Google Business Profile.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Add JSON-LD LocalBusiness/Electrician schema (name, address 1068 E 1300 S Salt Lake City, phone, areaServed, services, AggregateRating 4.9/122) plus FAQ schema for EV/panel pages. Validate with Google Rich Results Test.

strengths: Strong reputation foundation: 4.9 stars from 122 reviews with 98% four- and five-star share and latest sampled review 2026-07-27 - indicates active demand and trust to convert site visitors.

Strong search and technical foundation to build on: Lighthouse SEO 92/100, responsive viewport detected, HTTPS true, 0 broken of 6 checked, sitemapPageCount 5 and crawled 6 pages with GA4 measurement stack.
Clear conversion path already present: Online booking or request link detected, 8 homepage CTA phrases detected, hasPhone true, and 2 forms on homepage / 3 forms on /pages/contact.
No major site errors: Homepage returned HTTP 200 at https://tor-electric.com/, canonical true, and internal links observed on homepage: 7 supporting navigation.
